PATNA HIGH COURT
NOTICE
With regard to filling up of the vacancies in the cadre of District
Judge (Entry Level), against 65°/o quota for the year 2023-24.
This is for information that the Court have been pleased to ask for list of contested
judgments (Civil & Criminal) delivered during the period from 2019 to 2023 from all the
eligible officers of Civil Judge (Senior Division) cadre who have completed three (03)
years of qualifying service in the said cadre as on 30.09.2024 for consideration of their
cases for promotion to the cadre of District Judge (Entry Level), against 65% quota for the
year 2023-24. The names of such officers are as under:-

The aforenamed officers have to send their list of contested judgments within a
fortnight strictly, from the date of communication from this Court through the Principal
District & Sessions Judges I Authority concerned as the case may be, in the prescribed
proforma annexed herewith.
The officers must ensure that the list of judgment they will be sending must be of
contested judgment only and they must keep the judgments in readiness so that they may
be in a position to send them on short notice. They are also directed to visit the website of
this Court regularly for further updates.
